_about: Save as records/<id>.json (nested folders allowed); id must equal the filename stem. kind: home-paper | archive-record | index-entry. Required: id, kind, title, source, language (array), fields (object). Supply nonempty fields OR nonempty literal reading; do not invent a transcript. Optional saved_result on index-entry is a local captured result path. Optional subjects: [{person: canonical-person-id, role: child, written: literal name}]. Set subjects_complete: true only after checking all subjects of the whole document, including initials. Check only your files: instance check --path records/your-folder or --prefix records/your-prefix. Optional record_role=analysis for researcher comparisons/summaries, or catalogue for source maps/catalogues: retained as material, excluded from personal source visits.
